about: Sequent Scientific is India's leading animal health company, with presence in 5+ continents across 100 countries. Sequent Scientific Limited provides a wide-ranging portfolio of animal health products, including Finished Dose Formulations, APIs, as well as analytical services to the pharmaceutical and life sciences industries.
